caption: The drawing depicts a detailed textile or tapestry design with a predominantly red background and intricate white patterns. The main design features a large section filled with swirling floral motifs, leaves, and scrolls. Prominently within the pattern are a variety of animals and birds: one can see birds in flight and at rest, a deer-like animal standing on the left side, and a large bird with outstretched wings near the center. There are also architectural or decorative elements such as a small building or pavilion at the lower left corner. The border along the bottom and sides consists of repeating floral and scroll motifs. Toward the bottom right, a smaller rectangular section displays a bird perched on a branch surrounded by foliage, isolated from the main pattern. The entire composition uses red as the background color and white for the design elements, creating a high-contrast and detailed visual effect. At the lower left, text printed in red reads "BYRON A. DINGMAN ALLISON PARK PA."
title: Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
